name: Chambolle-Pock Algorithm
definition: A proximal algorithm used to solve complex optimization problems by splitting them into smaller, independent sub-problems (proximal operators) that are solved and combined. It is used for CT reconstruction formulated as an optimization problem.
summary: The Chambolle-Pock algorithm is a first-order primal-dual optimization method for tomographic reconstruction that efficiently handles non-smooth regularizers via splitting, often requiring fewer iterations than sibling methods.
